_comment: Docker daemon configuration for the Core host (Xavier, 10.0.7.127).
Merge into the existing /etc/docker/daemon.json rather than replacing it — the runtimes
block is what lets GPU containers start, and losing it is not obvious until something
needs CUDA. Then restart dockerd, which also restarts Pi-hole and briefly takes LAN DNS
The dns list pins every container to Pi-hole at 10.0.7.127 so that upstream lookups go
through the filter. Docker's documented behaviour is to fall back to Google's 8.8.8.8 and
8.8.4.4 when the host's /etc/resolv.conf holds only loopback addresses — which is exactly
what this host has (127.0.0.53, the systemd-resolved stub). Docker currently reads the real
upstreams out of /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf and lands on 10.0.7.127 anyway, so this
is insurance rather than a repair: it stops a resolved reconfiguration from silently moving
every container's lookups off the filtered path.
Pi-hole's own container sets dns: [1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9] in its compose file. That per-container
override wins over this default, so Pi-hole does not end up pointed at itself.
JSON has no comments; dockerd ignores unknown keys, so this one is harmless.
